headline: Master Trainer First
title: Pick This Talent First | Master Trainer | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Do not use Experience Gems yet. First pick the Master Trainer talent. It gives ten percent extra experience from catching and defeating Aniimo, and from using experience items. If you use a gem before you unlock it, you lose that ten percent for good. So grab Master Trainer first, then spend your gems. What talent did you pick first? Comment below!
description: Aniimo beginner tip: unlock the Master Trainer talent before you use Experience Gems. It adds 10 percent experience from catching, battling and experience items, and gems used earlier miss that bonus.
